errors.not_registered: You are not registered. Ask an admin for access.

errors.insufficient_role: This command requires the {required} role; yours is {actual}.
errors.unknown_command: Unknown command: {command}. Type /help for the list.
errors.migration_required: The database has not been updated for this build. Run this migration in Supabase (SQL Editor), then send the command again:
errors.parse_failed: Could not understand that command. Type /help for examples.
errors.addin_not_polling: No Revit add-in picked this command up after {seconds} seconds (it polls every {poll}). Open the model in Revit, start polling in the Command Center, and send the command again.
errors.timeout: Command timed out. Check that the Revit add-in is running.
errors.credential_expired: Your API credential has expired. Run /api connect again.
errors.your_telegram_id: Your Telegram ID is {id} — give it to an admin so they can register you.
errors.nlp_unavailable: Plain-language messages are off: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set on the server. Slash commands still work — see /help.
errors.low_confidence: I understood that as a device command but was not sure enough to run it. Rephrase it, or use the exact form from /help.
errors.not_a_device_command: I understood the sentence, but it is not a Revit command. This bot places and modifies electrical elements — see /help for what it can do.
errors.nlp_error: The Claude API call failed, so plain-language messages cannot be handled right now. Slash commands still work. The API said:
errors.bad_telegram_id: That is not a Telegram id. It is a number — the bot tells anyone their own when they message it.
errors.user_not_found: No user with that Telegram id. They must message the bot once first.
errors.nothing_to_undo: No recent placement of yours to undo in this project.
errors.cannot_remove_self: You cannot remove yourself — that would leave the project without you as admin.
